name: Kitchen Chaos
hook: Chop, cook and serve before orders run out.
how: Tickets come in for salads and burgers. Grab from the crates, chop at the board, cook meat on the stove before it burns, stack it all on a plate and serve it at the window. Late tickets cost points. A round lasts 3 minutes.
controls: WASD, Space to grab, put down or serve, hold E to chop. On a phone: drag to walk, GRAB and CHOP buttons
uses: The host's browser keeps every ingredient, timer, ticket and the score; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The team's score at the end of a round.
AI cooks pick up the next job the tickets need until enough people join.
Everyone sees the same kitchen, every chop and every sizzle.
ideas: Add a fire you put out with an extinguisher
Add a level where the counters move
Turn it into a pizza shop
